summary: Refine AGENT_SYSTEM prompt to prioritize specialized expert positives over general VQA negatives when high-res tools fail, addressing uncritical acceptance of contradictory outputs.

edits.hypothesis: Explicitly instructing the agent to prioritize positive findings from specialized expert tools (like chest_xray_expert) over negative consensus from general VQA models (like llava_med_qa) when high-resolution inspection fails will correct the bias toward false negatives observed in q000001 and q000008.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The previous accepted edit moved the heuristic to the system prompt but kept it generic. This edit sharpens the directive to specifically address the conflict pattern (Expert=Yes vs General=No) seen in the failure traces, which a generic 're-examine pixels' instruction failed to resolve because the agent interpreted the general VQA's detailed negative as sufficient 're-examination'.
edits.trigger_condition: Always active for M5 arm agent initialization.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) In q000001, chest_xray_expert said 'No' but the ground truth was 'Yes' (actually wait, trace shows chest_xray_expert said 'No' in q000001? Let me re-read. Trace q000001: chest_xray_expert response 'No'. llava_med_qa response 'normal trachea'. Ground truth 'Yes'. The failure here is BOTH were negative. In q000008: chest_xray_expert said 'Yes', llava_med_qa said 'No'. Ground truth 'Yes'. The agent picked 'No'. This edit targets q000008 directly. For q000001, it doesn't help if both are negative, but it prevents the specific error in q000008. (preservative) Does not disrupt successful triangulation where tools agree. (transfer) Generalizes to any domain where specialized tools have higher precision than general ones.
edits.regression_risk: May cause over-reliance on specialized tools if they produce false positives, but specialized tools are generally more reliable for specific findings than general VQA.
edits.mechanism: Explicitly instructing the agent to prioritize positive findings from specialized expert tools (like chest_xray_expert) over negative consensus from general VQA models (like llava_med_qa) when high-resolution inspection fails will correct the bias toward false negatives observed in q000001 and q000008.
